translation.note: No verified validated Chinese version of this exact item set located in this pass. Do not identify as an official Chinese edition.

administration.timeframe: General self-description, not a specified recent-week recall period
administration.instructionZh: 请根据你通常的情况，判断以下说法与你的符合程度。没有标准答案，请按自己的真实感受作答。

responseOptions.zh: 介于不符合与符合之间

administration.populationCaution: Adult research-only is a conservative project use boundary, not proof of validation in Chinese adults, teachers or minors.

scoring.missing: Require all 10 responses; no imputation. This is a project implementation choice, not a source-defined missingness rule.

norms.note: No cutoffs, diagnostic bands, Chinese percentiles or school norms are supported by the reviewed official pages. Do not use response-range thirds as empirical thresholds.

attribution: Barchard (2001), as attributed by the official IPIP key; do not claim a complete emotional-intelligence battery.

items.en: Think about the causes of my emotions.
items.zh: 我会思考自己产生情绪的原因。

items.en: Pay a lot of attention to my feelings.
Am usually aware of the way that I'm feeling.
items.zh: 我通常能觉察到自己当下的感受。

items.en: Often stop to analyze how I'm feeling.
items.zh: 我常常停下来分析自己的感受。

items.en: Rarely think about how I feel.
items.zh: 我很少思考自己有什么感受。
我很少分析自己的情绪。

items.en: Am not in touch with my feelings.
items.zh: 我不太能觉察到自己的感受。
我经常忽略自己的感受。
我很少留意自己的情绪反应。

reliability.interpretation: Group-level original source coefficients, not current Chinese reliability or individual accuracy.

construct: Self-reported tendency to notice, attend to and reflect on emotions; not emotion-recognition accuracy, regulation skill, or emotional intelligence.

feedback.summary: 分数概括你对自己情绪进行留意和思考的自述倾向。较高分数不等于情绪调节更好，较低分数也不意味着能力不足。
feedback.reflection: 可以回想一次最近的情绪变化：你注意到了什么身体感受、想法或行动冲动？
feedback.action: 尝试用一个词为感受命名，再把注意力转向当下可做的一件小事；不必反复分析或追求完全理解每一种情绪。
feedback.limits: 不用于诊断、学生筛选、教师考核或能力排名；没有可用的项目常模或经验分界值。
